date_note: The pages give only their publication day (24 Nov 2026) and say the attack happened recently; no earlier day is stated.
title: Media report: hacker reportedly accessed a US government system, CIA and ODNI said to be affected
geo_basis: agency headquarters; the reports name no location for the system
summary: German agency reports (APA, dpa-AFX) say the New York Times reported, citing government officials and others familiar with the matter, that the CIA was hit by a suspected hacking attack and that some unclassified information was reportedly exposed. A hacker reportedly gained unauthorized access to at least one government system that collects and analyses publicly available data; the Office of the Director of National Intelligence was also said to be affected. The reports cite no official statement.
plain: German news agencies relay a New York Times report that a hacker got into a US government system used for public data, affecting the CIA and ODNI. No official statement is cited.
exec: A reported, unconfirmed breach of a US intelligence-linked system; unclassified information was reportedly exposed.

validation.note: Both pages relay the same New York Times report (via APA/dpa); neither cites an official statement. The original NYT article was not read. Kleine Zeitung and otz.de could not be loaded.
